summary.text: Jeff Monroe is the Republican candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 37, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Michelle French.

paragraphs.text: Monroe and John Jacobs advanced to a runoff after the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, in which both defeated Donna McKay.
Monroe then defeated Jacobs in the June 16, 2026, runoff with 60.9 percent of the vote.
